notes: The supplied files cover one catchment, not 5 independent catchments or 35 monitoring sites.
Qcumecs was preserved without unit conversion because the variable magnitude and units must be independently verified.
Additional monthly-distribution files and lognormal_observed_TRP.csv are not treated as timestamped field measurements.
No river-network edges can be inferred from this single site series.
Valid supervised rows have one-day-separated adjacent samples and lagged features.
